mapper.sql: p.id,p.owner_id,p.deleted,p.status,p.row_version,p.latest_version_id,p.published_version_id, v.id AS version_id,v.version_no,v.title,v.description,CAST(v.tags AS CHAR) AS tags_json, v.difficulty,CAST(v.allowed_first_seats AS CHAR) AS allowed_first_seats_json, CAST(v.initial_state AS CHAR) AS initial_state_json,v.state_hash, (SELECT sr.winner_side FROM solve_task st JOIN solve_result sr ON sr.task_id=st.id AND sr.deleted=0 WHERE st.puzzle_version_id=v.id AND st.deleted=0 AND st.source_type='PUZZLE_VERSION' AND st.purpose='ANALYSIS' AND st.task_status='COMPLETED' AND st.solver_version=#{proofSolverVersion} AND st.ruleset_version=v.ruleset_version AND st.state_hash=v.state_hash AND st.state_snapshot=v.initial_state AND sr.proof_status='PROVEN' AND sr.winner_side IN ('USER','BOT') ORDER BY sr.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS winner_side
mapper.select: SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.id=COALESCE(p.published_version_id,p.latest_version_id) AND v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE 1=1 AND p.deleted=0 AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY p.update_time DESC,p.id DESC

SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted=0 AND v.id=COALESCE(#{versionId},IF(p.status='PUBLISHED',p.published_version_id,p.latest_version_id)) LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE p.id=#{id} AND v.id=COALESCE(#{versionId},IF(p.status='PUBLISHED',p.published_version_id,p.latest_version_id)) LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE v.initial_state=CAST(#{stateJson} AS JSON) AND p.id<>#{excludePuzzleId} ORDER BY p.deleted ASC,p.update_time DESC,v.version_no DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE v.id=#{versionId} AND p.deleted=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM puzzle p JOIN puzzle_version v ON v.id=p.published_version_id AND v.puzzle_id=p.id AND v.deleted=0 WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted=0 ORDER BY p.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO puzzle_version(id,create_time,update_time,create_by,update_by,deleted,puzzle_id,version_no,title,description,tags,difficulty,allowed_first_seats,ruleset_version,schema_version,initial_state,state_hash) VALUES(#{versionId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),1,1,0,#{id},#{versionNo},#{title},#{description},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{difficulty},CAST(#{allowedFirstSeatsJson} AS JSON),'CLASSIC_V1',1,CAST(#{initialStateJson} AS JSON),#{stateHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE puzzle SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),latest_version_id=#{versionId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND status<>'ARCHIVED' AND deleted=0

UPDATE puzzle SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status='PUBLISHED',published_version_id=#{versionId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND latest_version_id=#{versionId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE puzzle SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status='ARCHIVED',deleted=1,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted=0 AND status<>'ARCHIVED'

UPDATE puzzle SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status='DRAFT',deleted=0,published_version_id=NULL,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted=1 AND status='ARCHIVED'
